segments.title: Rock + HYDROGEN + heat makes what?
segments.say: Scientists heated rock to over twelve hundred degrees in hydrogen. What came out? Gold, water, or diamonds? Comment your answer. Three. Two. One.

segments.title: WATER!
segments.sub: Almost **80%** of the iron oxide turned into iron + water
segments.say: Water! Almost eighty percent of the iron oxide turned into iron and water vapor.

segments.title: Earth may have MADE its oceans
segments.sub: Maybe **hundreds of oceans' worth**, says the lead scientist
segments.say: So the young Earth may have made much of its own water. Maybe hundreds of oceans' worth.

segments.title: Still being tested
segments.sub: Source: **University of New Mexico**, Nature Geoscience
segments.say: How much of today's water came this way is still unknown.
